justification.text: `n / sqrt (log n)` is the problem's own lower-bound function `n / √(log n)`; its divisor is zero only at n = 0 and n = 1 (log 0 = log 1 = 0), where Lean returns 0, and `=O[atTop]` is a statement about all sufficiently large n, unchanged by finitely many values, so the asymptotic claim is the informal text's.

This is the denominator of n/√(log n) in a big-O along atTop, so only large n matter. For n ≥ 2, log n > 0 and the square root is positive; the junk values at n ≤ 1 cannot change whether n/√(log n) = O(distinct distances).
